0.long_answer: Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) is a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by pervasive symptoms of inattention, hyperactivity, and impulsivity. It is commonly seen in individuals with developmental coordination disorder (DCD), with approximately 50% of those with DCD also exhibiting symptoms consistent with ADHD. This co-occurrence suggests that many individuals experiencing motor coordination difficulties associated with DCD may also face additional challenges related to attention regulation and behavioral impulsivity, which are hallmark features of ADHD.
